instruction: Turn on INTERACTIVE RELOADS in VR SETTINGS > INTERACTION. Say your perk, dominant hand, and Solo or Join.
watch: Say whether RELOAD HINTS, MANUAL PUMP and BODY HOLSTERS are on.

instruction: Empty the pistol: dry fire clicks and keeps the magazine. Eject with X/A or a pouch grab, seat the new one, rack.
watch: Slide stays locked back until racked; fires on the next pull; nothing moves before the magazine is in.

instruction: Insert from the left, right, above and at bad angles. Release early once; release after a partial insert once.
watch: Wrong-side or sideways approaches must not latch; early release drops it; a partial release settles once.

instruction: Reload with rounds left, then fire straight away.
watch: No rack needed; round count; the old magazine drops; the HUD shows 0 while it is out.

instruction: After seating into an empty gun press gun-hand X/A instead of racking. Then swap weapons after seating and come back.
watch: X/A drops the slide; a pending lock only ticks the trigger until X/A or a free-hand rack.

instruction: Empty reload and top-up on each. Use your perk's elite reload if you have one.
watch: Magazine path and fit in the hand; slide lock on each; the HMTech dart still fires with a pending lock.

instruction: Empty reload on both: seat, then pull the bolt from closed and let go.
watch: Bolt travel reads; the SA80 rear magwell is reachable; two-hand support does not fight the pull.

instruction: Empty reload: seat the magazine, pull the bolt handle straight back and let go. Then a top-up.
watch: Bolt cover rides the bolt; magazine path from the pouch; magazine and well glow placement.

instruction: Empty reload with the drum, pulling the charging handle; then a top-up.
watch: Drum fits the hand and seats; handle stroke reads; drum glow visible from where you look.

instruction: Empty reload: the bolt stroke is short. Then a top-up and a heal dart.
watch: Rack registers without over-pulling; the fold-out handle rides the bolt; the dart is unaffected.

instruction: Empty reload: pull the rear charging handle; watch the bolt carrier through the ejection port. Then a top-up.
watch: Bolt follows the handle and sits shut after; handle glow at the rear; the fore-grip support does not fight the pull.

instruction: Empty reload with the side charging handle, then a top-up.
watch: Bolt follows; the glow strip along the receiver reads as the part to pull; the magazine seats in the well.

instruction: Empty reload: pull the rear charging handle; then a top-up. Try it carried one-handed, then two-handed.
watch: Bolt follows; the grip glow reads as the magwell; reach from the pouch on a short gun.

instruction: Empty reload: pull the top-left charging handle (a short stroke). Then a top-up.
watch: Rack registers; the rear stop is silent by design and the return sounds; the lower housing glow reads as the magwell.

instruction: Empty reload: the magazine leaves from the top; seat the new one along the receiver top, then pull a front handle.
watch: Drop direction; insertion path along the top; receiver glow under the magazine; handle glow at the front.

instruction: Empty the drum: the handle should stay back. Seat a drum, then pull and release the top handle. Then a top-up.
watch: Handle holds back on empty; the drum seats in the well from below; bolt follows the handle.

instruction: Empty reload: pull the top charging handle; then a top-up. One-handed and two-handed.
watch: Bolt follows; the magazine seats up the grip; reach from the pouch on a short gun.

instruction: Empty the magazine: the handle should stay back. Seat a magazine, then pull and release the top handle. Then a top-up.
watch: Bolt and handle hold back on empty and release together; the curved magazine seats along its arc.

instruction: Empty reload: pull the side charging handle; then a top-up.
watch: Rack registers; the magazine and well glows line up; stock audio sounds right with the hand.

instruction: Empty reload: seat the drum, pull the side handle; then a top-up.
watch: Drum seats from below; bolt follows the handle; the reload sounds follow the hand.

instruction: Empty reload of the main magazine: seat it, pull the bolt handle. Then switch to the launcher and reload it.
watch: Main magazine is physical; the launcher keeps its stock reload and the magazine session never takes it.

instruction: Empty reload: lock the handle back before the magazine, seat it, then slap or press X/A (its bolt release). Then a top-up.
watch: Bolt follows the handle; the reload sounds follow the hand.

instruction: Empty reload: before the magazine, pull the left handle fully back and let go so it parks in its notch; seat the magazine, then slap it (pull a little and let go). Also try it without locking first.
watch: Bolt follows; the curved magazine seats along its arc; the reload sounds follow the hand.

instruction: Empty reload: seat the magazine, pull the fold-out handle; then a top-up.
watch: The held magazine shows its body and rounds in the gun's own colours; the healing dart keeps its stock reload.

instruction: Empty reload: seat the magazine, pull the fold-out handle; then a top-up.
watch: The held magazine shows its body and rounds in the gun's own colours; bolt and handle return shut.

instruction: Empty the pistol: the slide stays back. Seat a magazine, then rack or press X/A.
watch: Slide holds back on empty; releases on rack or button; sounds land on the slide.

instruction: Empty the pistol: the slide stays back. Seat a magazine, then rack or press X/A.
watch: Slide holds back on empty; the rounds are gone from the dropped magazine.

instruction: Empty reload: drop the magazine, seat a new one.
watch: No rack step: the reload completes on the seat with its electric charge-in sound.

instruction: Fire it dry, load shells one at a time into the port, then pump. Fire and pump a few times.
watch: Shells load like the MB500; its own rack and insert sounds; the pump ejects a hull at the rear stop.

instruction: Fire, pull the barrel down by hand (or X/A), load the grenade, flick or push it shut.
watch: Latch click then the barrel drops and the spent case ejects; insert and close sounds land on the hand.

instruction: Fire, swing the barrel out, load the round, close it.
watch: The barrel swings sideways about the bore (not down); barrel smoke on opening.

instruction: Fire some shells, open, load each empty chamber, close. Then a partial reload.
watch: Four hulls eject on opening; each shell seats in its own chamber; live shells stay visible.

instruction: Empty it, then reload: the first shell goes into the open ejection port, the rest into the tube. Fire without pumping.
watch: The bolt is open while the first shell drops in and closes by itself; no pump after shots; shell sounds on contact and seat.

instruction: Fire, then grab the bolt handle: lift it and pull it back, load the round, push it forward and down.
watch: The bolt follows the hand along its lift-then-pull path; the spent case ejects on opening; bolt sounds on lift, rear, forward and down.

instruction: Fire some rounds, open the bolt, press a stripper clip into the guides, close the bolt. Then a partial reload.
watch: One clip loads every missing round; the bolt handle lifts and turns as the bolt slides; clip-out and bolt-close sounds on closing.

instruction: Empty it, reload: the first round chambers through the open action, the rest go through the side gate one at a time.
watch: Each round seats from the hand into the gate; the lever works on the stock clock; gate and chamber sounds differ.

instruction: Empty it, reload one round at a time; then a top-up.
watch: Rounds load like the Winchester; scope stays clear of the hand.

instruction: Open the cylinder (grab and swing it out, or X/A), seat the speedloader, flick or push it closed.
watch: Cases eject on opening; one speedloader loads every round; a wrist flick closes it; rounds show live after the seat.

instruction: Open, seat the speedloader, close (flick or push).
watch: Same as the .500 with its own sounds; six rounds.

instruction: Open the feed cover by hand, let the old box drop, seat a new box, close the cover.
watch: Old box falls and lands; new box and belt load every round; the belt shows after the seat.

instruction: Open the cover, seat the new box, close it.
watch: Cover swings about 55 degrees; box and belt sounds land on the hand.

instruction: Same as the Stoner.
watch: Same as the Stoner with a 60-round box.

instruction: Open the loading lever (pin slides out), let the old cylinder drop, seat a loaded one, close the lever.
watch: The old cylinder falls and lands; one seat loads all six; pin, lever and hammer sounds on closing.

instruction: Empty it, then load grenades one at a time into the open canister.
watch: Each grenade is drawn from its own mesh and texture; the canister indexes after each one on the stock clock.

instruction: Pause a second at each step of an empty reload, then do a fast one. Dry fire twice on an empty gun.
watch: Only the next part glows after the pause; a fast reload shows nothing; two dry fires show it at once; no flicker between eyes.

instruction: With BODY HOLSTERS on, grip at the hip near the pouch and near the holster. Grip at the pouch with a full gun.
watch: The nearer target wins; a full gun's squeeze stays an ordinary grip; no accidental reload while fighting.

instruction: Empty the shotgun. The first shell goes in through the ejection port, the rest into the tube. Pump, fire.
watch: First-shell ring or ghost at the port after a pause; shell in the fingers; pump glow until chambered.

instruction: Pump at comfortable and fast speeds with the support hand, in hold and toggle grip. Release at the rear once.
watch: Stroke ownership; rear stop and forward lock feel; releasing at the rear needs another full stroke.

instruction: Top up a part-loaded gun by gripping at the pouch, no X/A. With MANUAL PUMP on, fire and pump between shots.
watch: The pouch grip starts it; shell count; fire withheld until a full stroke; sounds at both stops.

instruction: Open with X/A, then with the fore-end trigger grip. Load two shells; close by grip-up, muzzle-up flick, muzzle-down flick.
watch: Breech glow until the first shell; shells follow the hinge; the flick never fires; fire blocked while open.

instruction: One-shell top-up; one-shell reserve; open a full gun and close it.
watch: The right number of shells asked for; opening a full gun changes no ammo; sound and smoke at the open.

instruction: Switch the dominant hand in VR settings and repeat one pistol, one rifle and the shotgun reload.
watch: Pouch on the correct hip; mirrored hand pose; anything that is only wrong on one side.

instruction: Describe reload sounds and pulses on a pistol, a rifle and the shotgun.
watch: Eject, contact, seat, rear stop, return: once each, at the hand, audible over gunfire; a failed insert double-pulses.

instruction: Empty it, swap the magazine, then pull the charging rod under the carry handle. Then a top-up, then fire the M26 and let it reload.
watch: The rod moves with the hand, not the carry handle; mag out, mag in and bolt sounds at their moments; the M26 reload stays stock.

instruction: Empty it, swap the magazine, rack the left-side handle. Then a top-up.
watch: The bolt follows the handle; mag and handle sounds at their moments.

instruction: Empty it, swap the magazine, pull the T-handle. Then fire the M203 and let it reload.
watch: The latch and bolt follow the handle; the M203 reload stays stock.

instruction: Empty it (the slide holds back), swap the magazine, release or rack the slide. Then a top-up.
watch: Both barrels' slide moves as one; the slide-release sound plays on closing.

instruction: Fire both barrels, break it open, load two shells, flick it shut. Then a one-shell top-up.
watch: Opens and closes like the hunting shotgun; the breech hint shows both chamber mouths; open, insert and close sounds.

instruction: Fire all four, break it open (it drops almost straight down), load four shells one at a time, close it.
watch: Each shell seats in the next barrel; four casings eject on opening; bullet-in sound per shell.

instruction: Empty it, swing the cylinder out, push a speedloader in, flick it shut.
watch: The loader carries five shotshells; the open cylinder shows empty; the empty loader falls away on seating.

instruction: Empty it, break it open, let the old cylinder drop, seat a full cylinder, close it.
watch: The barrel and cylinder swing together; cylinder out, cylinder in and close sounds; all six flares show when closed.

instruction: Empty it, pull the drum, seat a full one. Then a top-up.
watch: No floating spare drum beside the gun; the hammer cocks after an empty reload with its sound; the drum turns per shot.

scenario: HZ12, HRG Incendiary, Teslauncher, Medic GL, Boomy, riot-shield G18, Sonic Gun, Seal Squeal
instruction: On each: empty it, swap the magazine, work the pump, handle or slide. Then a top-up.
watch: The new magazine seats from the hand; the handle or pump follows the hand; the G18 slide and Boomy bolt hold back when empty; underbarrel launchers keep their stock reload.

scenario: Nailguns, Laser Cutter, Microwave Assault, Storm Cannon, Shrink Ray, Minigun, Parasite Implanter, Gravity Imploder, Bladed Pistol, Medic Bat
instruction: On each: empty it, pull the magazine, battery or box, seat a new one.
watch: The reload completes on the seat; the gun's other parts finish on their own with their sounds (Nailgun air, Microwave barrel, Parasite bolt); battery arcs still show.

scenario: CaulkBurn, Flamethrower, Microwave Gun, Arc Generator, Seeker Six, Locust, Thermite Bore
instruction: Empty each, pull the tank, battery or rocket pod, seat a full one.
watch: Prop matches the part on the gun; doors, handles and spinners still move and sound; no floating spare.

instruction: Fire, then push a new rocket into the muzzle.
watch: Contact sound as the rocket's nose enters the tube, seat sound when it locks; no eject sound.

instruction: Winterbite: break open, swap the cylinder, close. Scorcher: empty it, open it (it turns about the bore), load a flare, flick it shut.
watch: Same feel as the Flare Gun and HX25; the Scorcher's spent casing does not stay drawn in the open breech.

instruction: Empty it, swing the housing out, push the speedloader in, swing it shut.
watch: The lock and slide frame retract with the housing; the loader carries seven darts and falls away empty; steam, open, pop, cartridge and close sounds.

weapon: Freeze Thrower, Healthrower, Ballistic Bouncer, Mine Reconstructor
instruction: Empty each, pull the cartridge or canister, push a new one in until it takes.
watch: It takes at the open chamber or partway in, then the gun closes or slides it home by itself; the Bouncer and Reconstructor canisters show full liquid after the reload.

instruction: Pulverizer: empty it, swap the shell clip. Doshinegun: empty it, push a wad of dosh into the box. Frost Fang: load shells one at a time.
watch: The Pulverizer clip carries its four shells (no doubled shells on the gun); no dosh wad floats beside the Doshinegun and none drops at the start; the Frost Fang shell seats with its insert sound.

instruction: Fire and let it reload.
watch: No battery pair floats behind or below the gun; the stock reload still runs.

instruction: Open the menu or cover a controller mid-rack and mid-carry; throw a grenade after seating.
watch: On recovery nothing chambers or seats by itself; the hand returns cleanly; no stuck reload.

instruction: On a dedicated server: fast empty and top-up reloads, then fire immediately. Say explicitly if not tested.
watch: HUD, magazine and reserve match after each reload; the first shot after a fast reload registers.

instruction: Describe anything else you tested, and what you would change. Say explicitly what was not tested.
watch: Other weapons, comfort, menus and requested changes.
